shell-n1-calc-total:
def calc_total(price, quantity):
    return price * quantity
shell-n2-result-type:
def result_type(a, b):
    return type(a + b).__name__
strings-n1-pick-quotes:
def quote_word():
    return 'a palavra "teste" está entre aspas'
strings-n2-build-fullname:
def full_name(first, last):
    return first + " " + last
strings-n3-ticket-banner:
def banner(title):
    top = "[ " + title + " ]"
    rule = "=" * len(top)
    return top + "\n" + rule
variables-n2-format-test-id:
def format_test_id(prefix, number):
    return prefix + "-" + str(number)
boolean-n1-is-active:
def is_active(logged_in, has_subscription):
    return logged_in and has_subscription
boolean-n2-can-access:
def can_access(is_admin, is_owner, banned):
    return (is_admin or is_owner) and not banned
boolean-n3-validate-login:
def validate_login(username, password):
    has_user = len(username) > 0
    has_pass = len(password) >= 6
    no_spaces = " " not in username
    return has_user and has_pass and no_spaces
